messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "525", "observation": "A loud, metallic impact and scraping sound occur, followed by a deep, resonant hum and a high-pitched electronic whine."}, {"id": "540", "observation": "A high-pitched electronic tone with a descending pitch glissando and a brief, sharp metallic click are audible."}, {"id": "555", "observation": "A deep, resonant musical drone underlies the scene, punctuated by a sudden, powerful explosion and metallic clatter."}, {"id": "570", "observation": "A loud, high-pitched scream is followed by a deep, rumbling sound and a sustained, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "585", "observation": "A high-energy, distorted electric guitar riff plays over a driving rock drum beat and bassline, creating an intense, fast-paced instrumental track."}, {"id": "600", "observation": "A distorted electric guitar plays a fast, aggressive rock riff with heavy metal effects, accompanied by a driving drum beat and bass guitar."}, {"id": "615", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with deep percussion and swelling strings builds tension before fading into a low, sustained ambient drone."}, {"id": "630", "observation": "A high-pitched, sustained electronic tone with a descending pitch glide and a brief, lower-pitched electronic tone follows."}]
